culpritSource.quote: The culprit is Masaya Amamori. First, at 7:25 he left the backyard saying he was going for a bit of coal he had already prepared the fishing line and pole you'd hid beforehand and carried out his trick before innocently going back to the party and he employed the newspaper sheets used for the stick to carry the coal. Judging by the length of the wire, the wire remained hooked up for ten minutes. In other words, they heard the gunshot at 7:35 which means the culprit left the party during the ten minute time frame from 7:25. He is the only one that could have done it.

summary.en: Kogoro has been called to the Sunflower Estate by Ryuichiro Kanazawa, he is called to investigate a stalker who is watching each and every move of the architect. Then after having barbeque, they hear a gunshot they rush to his room and find him dead. Architect Ryuichiro Kanazawa was shot in the head by the murderer, trying to conceal the murder as being done by the victim's stalker from the outside. Was this really the work of the stalker? or is the culprit among the three people.

suspects: Makoto Hayashida, Masaya Amamori, Mitsuko Kanazawa, and Kogoro Mouri
